verdict.rationale: SerpApi supports Google search operators like 'site:' which can be used to include or exclude specific domains (e.g., site:example.com or -site:example.com), giving developers a workaround to restrict/exclude domains, but there's no dedicated first-class parameter or documented feature specifically for domain inclusion/exclusion filtering. missing for 10: a documented dedicated domain-restrict/exclude parameter, explicit examples of exclude-domain usage, and independent confirmation this works reliably across engines.
